settings.directory.label: Desktop folder
settings.directory.description: The folder whose contents appear on the desktop.
settings.output.label: Show on output
settings.output.description: Connector name such as DP-1. Leave empty to show on every monitor.
settings.icon_style.label: Icon style
settings.icon_style.description: Image icons look like a normal desktop, but right click only works on the name under an icon. Glyph icons are monochrome, but the whole tile accepts right click.
settings.icon_style.glyph: Glyphs (right click anywhere on the tile)
settings.cell_size.label: Slot size (px)
settings.icon_size.label: Icon size (px)
settings.show_hidden.label: Show hidden files
settings.sort.label: Sort by
settings.sort.name: Name
settings.folders_first.label: Folders first
settings.thumbnails.label: Image thumbnails
settings.thumbnails.description: Show the picture itself instead of a generic image icon.
settings.thumbnail_max_mb.label: Largest image to thumbnail (MB)
settings.single_click.label: Open with a single click
settings.double_click_ms.label: Double-click interval (ms)
settings.extra_menu.label: Extra desktop menu entries
settings.extra_menu.description: One per line, as Label = command. Shown in the right-click menu of the empty desktop.
settings.padding_top.label: Top padding (px)
settings.padding_left.label: Left padding (px)
settings.padding_bottom.label: Bottom padding (px)
settings.padding_bottom.description: Space reserved at the bottom (for a bar or dock) when working out how many icons fit per column.
settings.rows.label: Icons per column
settings.rows.description: 0 works it out from the monitor height. Set a number if icons run off the bottom or leave a gap.
settings.hit_divisions.label: Right-click precision
settings.hit_divisions.description: Each empty slot is split into N x N click areas so the menu opens closer to the pointer. 1 is the default because more areas means more UI nodes, and Noctalia disables a layer whose script runs over its CPU budget. Raise it to 2 only if it stays smooth.
settings.hit_opacity.label: Click area opacity
settings.hit_opacity.description: The empty-space click areas are drawn almost invisible. Raise towards 1 to see them while debugging.
settings.label_backing.label: Name backing opacity
settings.label_backing.description: Optional translucent plate behind each icon name. Off by default; it is a flat box, not a shadow.
settings.empty_menu.label: Right-click menu on empty desktop
settings.empty_menu.description: Adds New folder, New file, Refresh and your own entries when you right-click empty space. Costs a hand cursor over the whole desktop (the only way to catch the click). Off by default; the right-click menu on icons always works.
